summary: Round 2 backend testing complete - all 10 pytest tests PASS (100%). Verified: /api/geocode & /api/reverse-geocode (Nominatim proxy) return valid results; POST /api/trips auto-generates share_id; GET /api/public/trips/{share_id} returns full payload (trip+flights+transport+stays+attractions+tickets); bidirectional ticket<->item link sync works end-to-end (create link, relink to another flight clears old flight ticket_id, ticket delete clears both flights, and item delete cascades to clear ticket.linked_item_id); POST /api/ai/parse-booking with gpt-5.4 correctly classifies text confirmations for stay/flight/attraction with populated required fields; image_base64 path (real JPEG with readable booking text) returns a valid non-'unknown' category.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_flight/transport/stay/attraction endpoints accept the full model as body (including trip_id) and overwrite the doc with data.dict(exclude={'id'}) - this means a client PATCH with a wrong/empty trip_id could clobber the doc's trip_id. Consider a dedicated *Update model with Optional fields (like TripUpdate) to make PATCH truly partial.

cascade_delete_trip does not clean up ticket cross-references beyond deleting tickets in the same trip - fine for now, but if a ticket could ever reference an item from another trip this would leave stale ticket_id values.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: each test run creates a TEST_ prefixed trip and cleans it up via the module-scoped fixture teardown (trip delete cascades flights/tickets).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL taken from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Round 2 endpoints verified in /app/backend/tests/backend_round2_test.py.
